title: Harden Dependabot policy for PDF tooling updates
description:
﻿Update `.github/dependabot.yml` so Dependabot no longer creates unsafe grouped PRs that combine routine PDF tooling updates with major `pdfjs-dist` migrations.

Context:
- Dependabot PR #118 attempted to update `pdfjs-dist` from 5.x to 6.x alongside `@types/pdfkit`.
- `pdfjs-dist` 6.x is a semver-major release with API removals, including lifecycle APIs relevant to the SRD importer.
- The D&D SRD importer currently depends directly on PDF.js extraction behavior, so `pdfjs-dist` major updates must be handled as intentional migration work, not as routine dependency-only PRs.
- `pdfkit` and `@types/pdfkit` are related PDF tooling dependencies, but they should not be grouped in a way that hides or blocks risky extraction-runtime updates.

Scope:
- Update Dependabot npm config only.
- Split PDF tooling groups so `pdfjs-dist` is not grouped with `pdfkit` / `@types/pdfkit`.
- Allow patch/minor updates for PDF tooling.
- Ignore semver-major updates for `pdfjs-dist`.
- Strongly consider also ignoring semver-major updates for `pdfkit`.
- Keep `@types/pdfkit` patch/minor updates allowed.
- Fix the missing configured `npm` label issue by either removing the label from Dependabot config or ensuring the repo label exists; prefer config cleanup unless there is a repo-wide reason to keep the label.

Suggested shape:
- Group `pdfjs-dist` separately as PDF extraction tooling with patch/minor only.
- Group `pdfkit` and `@types/pdfkit` separately as PDF generation tooling with patch/minor only.
- Add explicit `ignore` entries for:
  - `pdfjs-dist` semver-major
  - `pdfkit` semver-major, unless there is a clear reason not to

Acceptance criteria:
- `.github/dependabot.yml` validates according to GitHub Dependabot syntax.
- Dependabot will not open another routine PR for `pdfjs-dist` 5.x -> 6.x.
- Dependabot can still open patch/minor PRs for `pdfjs-dist`.
- Dependabot can still open patch/minor PRs for `pdfkit` and `@types/pdfkit`.
- The current risky PR #118 is either closed/ignored or documented as intentionally superseded by this policy.
- No dependency versions are changed in this bead.
- No generated files, lockfiles, Biome config, or unrelated repo config are changed.
- Final response explains the resulting Dependabot policy and why PDF.js major updates require a dedicated migration bead.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #121 (branch kk7-1yj-harden-config): split Dependabot PDF tooling groups + ignore pdfjs-dist/pdfkit majors, removed unconfigured npm label, documented PR #118 as superseded; locked Biome generated-data exclusion and documented ignore-boundary policy. npm run check exit 0, full suite 958 passed/3 skipped.
